required_stages.description: Allocate a fresh flat (N*C*H_out*W_out,) output of input's dtype inside run().

One logical pass with no global-memory intermediate (the output tiles may be spread over several launches): each output element is the max over its kernel_size x kernel_size window read in place from the NCHW input, with -inf for out-of-range taps, written exactly once with bounds masking.

forbidden_substitutions.message: A library pooling operation replaces the whole computation.
Window materialisation (unfold/im2col) is forbidden; the pooling must be a direct stencil.
Host-side tensor max over windows replaces the kernel reduction.
A padded or initialised copy of the input is forbidden; -inf padding must be realised inside the kernel.
No host-side dtype conversion is part of this operator.

required_evidence.message: No elementwise/tile max primitive found; the window reduction must be done in the kernel.
No -inf identity/fill found; out-of-range taps must behave as -inf.

outputs.aliasing: none; the returned flat (N*C*H_out*W_out,) tensor must be freshly allocated inside run() and must not share storage with input

timing_boundary.notes: The GPU time of all device work launched by run() is counted (here only the stencil kernel launch(es)); host-side H_out/W_out arithmetic, the output allocation call and zero-copy views are not GPU time. No padded copy, no unfold, no cast, no cached state across calls.
